notes.title: Creepy Tale 2 released!
notes.content:
Hi there!

I very happy to show our new game - Creepy Tale 2!

Free your little sister from the influence of a natural evil force in this horror puzzle adventure, sequel to the acclaimed Creepy Tale

KEY FEATURES
Solve ingenious puzzles that will lead Lars to his sister and the creature behind her kidnap.
Enjoy a narrative-focused, accessible gameplay suitable for any kind of player.
Explore a kingdom widely inspired by the legends of Central European oral tradition, where magic creatures try to coexist peacefully with mankind — and, sometimes, even protect them from evil forces.
Feel the gloomy essence of this creepy tale through its decadent cartoonish art style, aesthetically similar to games like Knock-knock! and Don’t Starve.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550510/Creepy_Tale_2/

notes.title: Thanks everyone for the feedback!
notes.content:
Hello!

Thanks everyone for the feedback!

We have updated the game many times since launch, constantly making fixes.

Your feedback on steam is very important and if you want to help us and support the game, write your review. Criticize the game, say that you don’t like it and we will try to fix it in the next update!
